Choose the one visible/enabled/clickable actual button whose exact text is the source-defined Allow or Delete in that dialog. Fail if zero or multiple, wrong title/bundle/window/session or unsupported locale.

Observe actual permission authResults and token grants, or save returned URIs/files, or delete true asset state; a click or title alone is not capability proof.
